scope: Independent source and offline synthetic-model review of per-domain occupancy bitmaps, ordered logical iteration, and reverse highwater shrink. No native engine integration approval.
sourceReview: Each Block value-initializes ceil(size/64) words independently for both domains. Only in-range slot mutations set bits; unused high bits in partial final words remain zero.

Forward masking shifts by local%64 in [0,63]. Reverse masking shifts by 63-local%64 in [0,63]. countr_zero/countl_zero are used only for nonzero words. Each block restarts its local word index independently.

next is inclusive and rejects from>=capacity, including no_slot. previous is exclusive, clamps before to capacity, rejects zero, and safely crosses block boundaries. Public entry points reject unknown domains before indexing.
Adoption builds bitmap/slot/free-chain/highwater metadata before publishing any State fields. Invalid or duplicate occupancy destroys only temporary metadata and leaves borrowed payload untouched.

Grow initializes empty bitmaps in pending Blocks. Throwing metadata/payload construction and callback failures cannot publish capacity or occupancy. Publication follows reserved vector capacity and moves unique_ptr blocks; original payload addresses stay fixed.

acquire and acquire_at set occupied and bitmap together under the exclusive lock; release validates generation/domain, clears both, then shrinks highwater through reverse scan. Primary and secondary occupancy remain separate.

ReadLease retains State and the shared lock across the walk. try_close requires the exclusive lock, clears state and destroys blocks before releasing the borrowed owner. Native readers do not implicitly join this lock.

Both domain walks compared before failure, after each injected null-allocation/throwing-allocation/constructor failure, and after retry publication.
Both open and closed invalid-domain iteration rejected; sentinel and empty/closed results verified.
Repeated stale-handle release rejected without bitmap mutation.

limitations: Synthetic storage callbacks only; no Bannerlord allocation, traversal, engine barrier, deployment or game execution.
ASAN is not a data-race or native-reader-quiescence proof.
Metadata allocation failures and generation exhaustion near UINT64_MAX are source-reviewed rather than exhaustively injected.
Transient independent model sources/binaries are under build/agent-storage and must be retained to replay this receipt.
